none: PAS LANCUM-E83F27: Roman Samian Ware/Terre Sigillata ware base sherd dating from 100-240AD.
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base sherd of Roman Samian Ware/Terre Sigillata ware AD100-240. This sherd is a footring from a bowl or cup, as it has a convex shape which is standard for the internal surface of the bottom of Samian ware vessel. The rest of the vessel has broken off. There is a makers stamp on the inside of the bowl which is partially illegible it possibly says NINIVSMA in which case ma is short for manu…
